findings.rationale: aws_security_group.jump permits ingress 0.0.0.0/0 tcp/22, exposing administrative SSH to the internet.
aws_iam_role.escalation is broadly assumable and is attached to AdministratorAccess through aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.escalation.
connectivity.json links sg-jump to role-escalate via sts:AssumeRole, connecting internet ingress to identity escalation.
tf_iam_open Statement[0] combined with the tf_s3_public_access public-read ACL links broad IAM access to public S3 exposure.
